[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
Version 1.4.3:[/size][/size][/size][/size]
- ﻿Fix sometime stuck in Menu window when interact with some furniture object (eg: Junimo Catalogue[/size][/size])

Version 1.4.2:[/size][/size][/size][/size]
- ﻿Fix sometime right-click action at the end of movement isn't working

- ﻿Fix sometime player can't right click when using chest/inventory﻿


Version 1.4.0:
- ﻿Fix how the mod handle action at the end of movement (which cause a lot of soft lock bug report), it should be more intelligent now
- Add config menu support through Generic Mod Config Menu ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url]﻿
[/size][/size][/size]- Add config to enable and disable Path finding[size=3][code]"EnablePathFinding": true[/code][/size]

Remember to delete the old config file if thing didn't work[/quote][b][size=6]
[/size][/b][/size][size=5][b]Mod feature[/b][/size][size=3][b][size=3]

[/size][/b][list]
[*]Right-click or Holding right mouse will make the player move, holding move stop the player after release
[*]Holding shift when riding will make right-click to be only move 
[*]Right-click too far from the player will perform an action on the pointed object when you come close
[/list][list]
[*]Press [b]F6[/b] for On/Off the Right mouse move mode in-game (auto [b]On [/b]at start, can change in config)
[*][i]Alt + Enter to change between fullscreen and window mode[/i]
[*][i]Crtl + Wheeling will zoom in and out[/i]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/DHUyCMT.gif[/img]

[/size][/size][size=5][b]Config file option[/b][/size][size=3][size=3][size=3][b]

[/b][/size][/size][code]﻿{
  "MouseWhellingZoomStep": 0.25,         (Increase it make wheel scroll quicker)
  "MouseWhellingMaxZoom": 2.0,
  "MouseWhellingMinZoom": 0.75,          (Extended Mode mouse wheel zooming cap)
  "FullScreenKeybindShortcut": "RightAlt + Enter"   (Some may want to use "F11")
  "ExtendedModeDefault": true,           (set it to false will disable Ctrl+Wheel and RightAlt+Enter)
  "RightClickMoveModeDefault": true,     (change it to 'false' will make the mod disable at startup)
  "RightClickMoveModeToggleButton": "G", (hotkey to enable/disable the mod in-game)
  "HoldingMoveOnly": true,               (only move player when holding right-mouse)
  "HoldTickCount": 15,                   (time of pressing mouse needed to be consider as holding)
  "WeaponsSpecticalInteraction": true,   (set it to 'false' disable the special handle for weapon)
  "WeaponsSpecticalInteractionType": 0,  (1 as default, value can be change to 0 1 2 3)
﻿  "EnablePathFinding": true,             (Enable path finding)
  "PathFindLimit": 500,                  (﻿Limit the total game tile will be search through)
  "ShowMousePositionHint": true          (Showing mouse indicator to control destination better)
}
[/code][size=3]

[u]WeaponsSpecticalInteraction:[/u] There is 3 mode to handle Special using right-click: 
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]0: [/size]No special handle for weapons[/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3]                      Right-click Special move only in a small radius (2 tiles) around the player 
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]1: Normal[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3]                     Replicate the normal game, but the special move will interrupt the moving
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]2: Disable Right-click Special move[size=3][size=3]  (default)[/size][/size][/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3]                     instead, press middle/X1 mouse [b]or left-click on the farmer[/b] to perform weapons special move[/size][/size][size=3][size=3]
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]3: Disable Right-click Special move (new)[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][size=3]                     instead, press middle/X1 mouse to perform weapons special move[/size][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][size=5][b]Motivation[/b][/size][size=3]

[size=3]Are you bored with the mouse being quite useless and always have to stay close to your character? So do I, and because of that, I make a little mod to enhance mouse function.

Is this complete yet? Well, [s]No for me[/s] It is almost stable as it is now you.
[/size]
[/size][size=5][b]How to install[/b][/size][size=3][size=4]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Step 1: Install SMAPI 4.1.1 or above[/size]
[*][size=3]Step 2: Download the zip file, and Extract [/size]
[*][size=3]Step 3: Place the folder that you get from step 2 to Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Step 4: Start complaining in the Post tab[/size]
[/list]
